note: Frozen snapshot of the per-claim audit outcomes behind reports/p65-external-audit.json: each third-party candidate, run once through the independent audit (novelty, Gaia dilution/blend, geometry, our own blind re-detection) and the deterministic BLIND critic, keeping the critic verdict, the passes-gate boolean, the reason and the diagnostic FAP/blend-score. The published passesCurrentGate array, the accepted / needs-more-data counts and anyAccepted are re-DERIVED offline from these outcomes' enum/boolean fields, so a clean checkout reproduces the report without re-fetching (which would re-measure and could move it -- the p90 drift lesson). The verdicts are exact enum strings, so re-deriving is byte-identical. measuredAt is when the committed live run gathered them; --live re-audits deliberately.
